name: Standard Meeting Notes
description: General meeting notes: summary, topics, decisions, actions and open points.
description_it: Note generali di riunione: sintesi, temi, decisioni, azioni e punti aperti.

sections.title: Summary
sections.instruction: 3-5 sentences: why the meeting took place, the main topics and the outcome

sections.title: Participants
sections.instruction: Real names of the people who took part, from the speaker names or from people addressed by name. Never list generic labels such as 'Speaker A' or 'Parlante B': if there are unnamed speakers, end with one item 'Other unnamed speakers'. If no real name appears, write 'Not stated'

sections.title: Topics Discussed
sections.instruction: One bullet per topic: a bold short title followed by 1-3 sentences on what was said and the positions that emerged

sections.title: Decisions
sections.instruction: Only points on which the participants explicitly agreed. Proposals or ideas still to evaluate are not decisions

sections.title: Action Items
sections.instruction: Every task someone took on. 'Who' and 'By when' only if stated in the call, otherwise 'Not stated'

sections.title: Open Points
sections.instruction: Questions left unanswered and topics postponed
